title: What is owed to a supplier after debit notes, credit held with them and payments: a debit note that leaves credit, a new purchase settled from that credit at once, and a payment after it

debit_note.note: A debit note of 115 taken from a purchase that was already paid leaves a credit of 115 with the supplier, with no cash given back

purchase_settled.note: A new purchase of 115 of a supplier with that credit is settled by it when it is created, as a payment of the supplier credit with no journal

payment_beyond.note: A payment of 50 after that shows the purchase paid in excess, 165 paid of 115, with a settle button, and its journal holds the 50

expected.why: money paid into a purchase that credit had settled takes back that much of the credit, so the purchase is paid and the supplier holds the same 50 in credit
